populations.intention_to_treat: all randomized eligible pairs, assigned condition regardless of realized abundance
populations.per_protocol: pairs meeting abundance manipulation checks and without artifact exclusion; sensitivity only

primary_analysis: Within each repository × task-class × difficulty stratum, compute paired HIGH−LOW differences for P1-P5 and stage binding status
Use task-template clustered bootstrap with 10000 resamples and fixed seed 11020260901; report two-sided 95% intervals and raw numerators/denominators
Estimate conditional mixed-effects models with condition, repository, task class, difficulty, order, and condition interactions; template and operator random intercepts
Apply frozen bottleneck criteria separately by condition, then apply the migration definition
Control primary familywise error at 0.05 using Holm across P1-P5; binding thresholds remain conjunctive effect-size criteria
artifact_checks: Repeat including and excluding instrumentation time; an apparent result that disappears only when overhead is included is H3-compatible
Report invalid-oracle/harness and environment rates by condition; imbalance >=0.10 or common defect triggers indeterminate/block rules
Gate-order sensitivity reports not-reached stages without treating them as passes
Check baseline balance and condition-by-repository/task/difficulty interactions
Compare ITT and per-protocol; failure of manipulation check cannot support migration
difficulty: Difficulty bands are frozen pre-outcome. Analyze within band and interaction; no aggregate conclusion may reverse both bands without DOMAIN_DEPENDENT or INDETERMINATE.
proportional_acceleration: H2 is compatible when HIGH/LOW median active-time ratios for every applicable S01-S11 stage fall within ±0.10 of their geometric mean, no binding stage changes, and throughput ratio is consistent with that common acceleration.
measurement_overhead: Instrumentation burden is acceptable when median <=5% of cycle time in both conditions and between-condition difference <=2 percentage points.
reporting: Publish every stratum, null/negative case, censored observation, exclusion, protocol deviation, manipulation result, and uncertainty interval. No post-hoc pooled-only claim.
